LCB.name: Joshua
LCB.answer2:
If the eight
philosophies of
avatarhood
combine into and
are made from
truth, love
& courage...
LCB.yes:
What one thing
creates and is
created by all
truths, all love
& all courage?

LCB.name: Juliet
LCB.answer1:
Seek ye to know
how the eight
virtues form
into the three
principles.
LCB.answer2:
Seek ye to know
what one thing
the three
principles of
virtue combine
into!

LCB.name: Jester Twin
LCB.answer1:
A jester needs
a good bard!
LCB.yes:
Then you should
go to Britain
for there lives
the best!

LCB.name: a guard
LCB.job:
I guard the
castle and my
liege!
LCB.answer1:
A guard must
be a valiant
warrior!
LCB.ask:
Art thou the
most valiant
warrior?
LCB.yes:
Then thou should
be a guard!

LCB.name: Le Chef
LCB.look:
A person with
a white hat.
LCB.health:
Well.. All but
my finger,
which I cut!
LCB.answer1:
Food, glorious
food, to cook is
my life!
LCB.yes:
Then thou should
try my soup!
LCB.no:
Then thou
must be a
spiritualist!

LCB.name: a reaper
LCB.health:
Not so good,
no one to eat
in here!
LCB.answer1:
There is a thing
which can kill
many!
LCB.answer2:
Knowledge of it
is found at
Buccaneer's Den!

LCB.name:
a nameless
prisoner
LCB.answer2:
Here I pay for
my crimes!
LCB.yes:
You may never
complete thy
quests, for evil
makes not an
avatar!
LCB.no:
I hope that
this is true!

LCB.name: Zorin
LCB.job:
I am here
to help thee.
LCB.answer2:
Seek:
the Lycaeum,
Empath Abbey,
Serpent's Castle!
LCB.yes:
Find therein all
named Antos and
ask of the bell,
book, and
candle!

LCB.name: a guard
LCB.job:
I guard the
castle and all
within.
LCB.answer2:
The castle is
fair and strong!
LCB.yes:
He is on the
upper level in
the throne room.
LCB.no:
He will aid
you if you
are in need!

LCB.name: Water
LCB.answer2:
There are three
altar rooms
which connect
the bottom
levels of all
eight dungeons!
LCB.yes:
If the correct
colors of stones
are used in the
altars, a key of
three parts can
be gained!

LCB.name: Shawn
LCB.look:
A shepherdess
both strong
and beautiful.
LCB.answer2:
I come from
a proud city.
LCB.no:
My towne was
destroyed for
its pride. The
ruins lie on an
isle at lat-K'J"
long-L'L"!

LCB.name: Seesha
LCB.yes:
Then seek out
the smith named
Zircon in Minoc
for he made the
mystic arms,
only they will
save thee in the
abyss!

LCB.name: Chuckles
LCB.answer2:
Speak ye unto
the waters of
the well and ask
of altars!

LCB.name: a guard
LCB.answer1:
We guard the
castle and its
treasures.
LCB.yes:
I believe you
will find that
an unfruitful
venture.

LCB.name: Sheila
LCB.job:
I search for
the inner light.
LCB.answer1:
Seek inner light
in the shrines!
LCB.answer2:
Runes are needed
to enter
shrines!
LCB.no:
The mantra are
chants needed
to
focus thy
thoughts while
meditating.

LCB.name: Landri
LCB.job:
I am here
to warn thee!
LCB.health:
I am fine, but
thou must
go back!
LCB.answer2:
Once thou enters
thou may not
return whence
thee came!

LYCAEUM.name: Robert Frasier
LYCAEUM.answer1:
My Lady Beth can
tell thee more!
LYCAEUM.answer2:
I know but
one of three
syllables.
LYCAEUM.ask:
Dost thou wish
to know it now?
LYCAEUM.yes:
It is 'ver'! Seek
ye now the
other parts!

LYCAEUM.name: Beth Frasier
LYCAEUM.answer2:
Our people
believe in truth
as a way of life
and live it to
the fullest!
LYCAEUM.no:
Then thou shalt
not find it!

LYCAEUM.name: a guard
LYCAEUM.job:
Guard the gate,
guard the baron,
guard the
baroness, watch
the towers....
LYCAEUM.answer1:
I have been here
for hours!
LYCAEUM.yes:
It's hard work
and long hours
in the baronial
guard!

LYCAEUM.name: Palamar
LYCAEUM.job:
I am an old
wizard, but have
much to show!
LYCAEUM.health:
My bones ache
but my mind
is sharp!
LYCAEUM.answer2:
Search there by
the end, thou
shalt find
a knob.
LYCAEUM.yes:
Set the dial and
thou shalt see!

LYCAEUM.name: Father Antos
LYCAEUM.look:
An old druid,
who looks
strangely
familiar.
LYCAEUM.health:
Old and frail,
I've seen many
quests!
LYCAEUM.answer2:
Seek ye the book
of truth where
other books lie.

LYCAEUM.name: Jon
LYCAEUM.answer2:
There are four
townes that
follow the
principle of
truth.
LYCAEUM.no:
There are
eight possible
combinations of
the three
principles,
there are eight
cities!

LYCAEUM.name: Scatu
LYCAEUM.look:
A tall mage
wearing strange
armour.
LYCAEUM.answer1:
Thou would be
well advised to
visit the Seer
often!
LYCAEUM.yes:
When thou art 8
parts avatar,
seek Zircon in
Minoc and ask of
mystics!

LYCAEUM.name: Estro
LYCAEUM.health:
Why I am fine,
you too I hope.
LYCAEUM.answer1:
I am looking for
the book of
justice!
LYCAEUM.yes:
I believe thou
art boasting
a lie!
LYCAEUM.no:
Then speak to
the judge in
Yew!

LYCAEUM.name: Tymus
LYCAEUM.answer1:
Yes, welcome to
the Lycaeum, the
keep of truth!
LYCAEUM.answer2:
The dungeon
altar rooms need
4 stones each!
LYCAEUM.ask:
Know ye how many
cities follow
the principles
of truth?

LYCAEUM.name:
a truth
seeker.
LYCAEUM.health:
I am in a
meditative
state.
LYCAEUM.answer1:
The principle
upon which I
meditate.
LYCAEUM.answer2:
Meditate at each
shrine for 1, 2
and 3 minutes,
then shalt thou
know the paths
of goodness!

LYCAEUM.name: a fighter
LYCAEUM.answer2:
I lost in a
dungeon altar
room!
LYCAEUM.yes:
Notice that
each of the
three rooms
connect to four
dungeons each!
LYCAEUM.no:
They connect the
dungeons unto
each other!

LYCAEUM.name: Lord Terence
LYCAEUM.answer1:
Herein is the
largest store
of knowledge in
Britannia except
the codex!
LYCAEUM.ask:
Art thou looking
for a particular
book?

LYCAEUM.name: Zajac
LYCAEUM.answer2:
Because my
friend Chuckles
won't tell me
his secret!
LYCAEUM.yes:
Why dost thou
not ask him for
his clue!
LYCAEUM.no:
He lives in
the castle
Britannia ask
him of his clue!

LYCAEUM.name: Catriona
LYCAEUM.answer1:
The treasures
are of great
value!

LYCAEUM.name:
Nigel, at thy
service.
LYCAEUM.answer2:
Yes,
resurrection
it takes: ash,
ginseng, garlic,
silk, bloodmoss,
and mandrake!
LYCAEUM.ask:
Dost thou know
what it is?
LYCAEUM.yes:
What do I call
the spell?

LYCAEUM.name: Shylock the Meek
LYCAEUM.job:
I sit and beg
oh... please...
LYCAEUM.health:
I am cold
and sick!
oh... please...
LYCAEUM.answer1:
Yes, please
give me money!
oh... please...
LYCAEUM.ask:
Wilt thou
help me?
Oh... please...

EMPATH.name: Lord Robert
EMPATH.answer1:
My Lady Marcy
can tell thee
more!
EMPATH.answer2:
I know but
one of three
syllables.
EMPATH.ask:
Dost thou wish
to know it now?
EMPATH.yes:
It is 'amo' seek
ye now the
other parts!

EMPATH.name: Lady Marcy
EMPATH.answer2:
Our people
believe in love
as a way of life
and live it to
the fullest!
EMPATH.no:
Then thou shalt
not find it!

EMPATH.name: Suzanna
EMPATH.job:
I am a lady
in waiting.
EMPATH.answer2:
There is a
paladin by the
name of Malchor.
He can lead thee
to the silver
horn!
EMPATH.ask:
Art thou allowed
to be in here?
EMPATH.yes:
I doubt it!
Thou should
leave!

EMPATH.name: Life.
EMPATH.answer2:
Seek ye the
candle of love
for only with it
and two other
parts might thou
enter the abyss!
EMPATH.no:
Ask the bard
beyond the
secret passage!

EMPATH.name: the pass guard
EMPATH.answer2:
Well not
compared to a
dungeon altar
room!
EMPATH.no:
From them a
three part key
is gained,
needed to enter
the chamber of
the codex!

EMPATH.name: a gate guard
EMPATH.answer2:
Here, in the oak
grove many find
the meaning of
peace and love!
EMPATH.yes:
Then thou need
not be here!
EMPATH.no:
Visit the small
shrine within
the abbey!

EMPATH.name: Derek the Bard
EMPATH.look:
A young bard
playing a lute.
EMPATH.job:
I am a bard,
I sing songs.
EMPATH.answer2:
The candle of
love is found in
a secret place
hidden off
Lock Lake!

EMPATH.name: Chinup
EMPATH.job:
I welcome thee
unto the Abbey!
EMPATH.answer2:
There four
profession types
seek truth!
EMPATH.ask:
Art thou here in
search of love?

EMPATH.name: Diane
EMPATH.job:
I counsel those
who enter
the grove.
EMPATH.answer1:
Herein thou may
find insights
into love,
within thyself
or the others
here in the
grove.
EMPATH.ask:
Art thou the
most loving
person?

EMPATH.name: Benjamin
EMPATH.answer1:
When the three
combine in eight
ways love alone
is compassion.
EMPATH.answer2:
Of the
eight avatar
attributes
compassion is
derived from
love alone.

EMPATH.name: Deirdre
EMPATH.answer1:
When three build
eight, truth
tempered by love
becomes justice!
EMPATH.answer2:
Justice is one
of the eight
avatar virtues
and derives from
truth and love.

EMPATH.name: Thomas
EMPATH.job:
I am thinking of
love's part in
sacrifice.
EMPATH.answer1:
Love of others
and the courage
to face even
death is
self-sacrifice.
EMPATH.answer2:
Sacrifice is
built upon the
motive of love
and the ability
of courage.

EMPATH.name: Lastro
EMPATH.answer1:
My spirituality
is not a
religion, but a
searching to
know and improve
my own inner
being.
EMPATH.answer2:
My being is
based on my own
truth, love and
courage.

EMPATH.name: Humlock
EMPATH.answer2:
I am but a poor
destitute beggar
I have nothing!
EMPATH.ask:
Will you give me
some money?
EMPATH.no:
But I am in
most dire need!

EMPATH.name: Malchor
EMPATH.answer1:
My last quest
took me near
Spiritwood.
EMPATH.answer2:
Some say that
the silver horn
is buried on a
small isle off
the tip of
Spiritwood.

EMPATH.name: Brother Antos
EMPATH.health:
I am getting old
and frail.
EMPATH.answer1:
What dost thou
ask of me?
EMPATH.answer2:
Thou dost need
the candle of
love to enter
the abyss.
EMPATH.ask:
Dost thou
know where
to find it?
EMPATH.no:
Meditate on love
at our shrine.

SERPENT.name: Sentri
SERPENT.answer1:
Yes, these
islands and
much more.
SERPENT.answer2:
I know but
one of three
syllables-'cor'.
SERPENT.ask:
Dost thou know
the four cities
of courage?
SERPENT.no:
They are Jhelom,
Minoc, Trinsic
and Skara Brae.

SERPENT.name: the gate guard.
SERPENT.answer1:
These are the
gates to Serpent
castle.
SERPENT.ask:
Art thou here to
find courage?
SERPENT.yes:
Then thou art at
the right place.
SERPENT.no:
Then perhaps to
become a guard!

SERPENT.name: Lassorn
SERPENT.answer2:
She went down in
the deep waters
of the bay in
the Cape of
Heroes!

SERPENT.name: Roark
SERPENT.answer1:
The Great
Stygian Abyss
holds the codex
of ultimate
wisdom!
SERPENT.yes:
Then strive to
find the secrets
of the abyss.
SERPENT.no:
Thou hast come
to the right
place.

SERPENT.name: a ranger.
SERPENT.answer1:
I train so that
I might survive
the dungeons!
SERPENT.answer2:
I plan to
conquer the
secret of the
altar rooms.
SERPENT.yes:
Ask our teacher
about the rooms
for she knowns
much!

SERPENT.name: Shyra
SERPENT.job:
I train warriors
to fight with
courage!
SERPENT.answer1:
Train well and
thy courage can
grow with
confidence.
SERPENT.answer2:
In the altar
room of courage
use the red,
orange, purple
and white
stones!

SERPENT.name: a baronial guard
SERPENT.answer2:
This castle is
built on
courage.
SERPENT.ask:
Dost thou wish
an audience
with Sentri?

SERPENT.name: a treasure guard
SERPENT.answer1:
This treasure is
not for thee
SERPENT.answer2:
Seek out Durham
for knowledge of
dungeons.
SERPENT.ask:
Dost thou intend
to steal
our lord's
treasure?

SERPENT.name: Garam
SERPENT.answer1:
Courage makes
kings out of
knaves!
SERPENT.answer2:
The bell of
courage lies at
the bottom of a
deep well at sea
found at
lat-N'A"
long-L'A"

SERPENT.name: Durham
SERPENT.answer1:
I feel that when
on a quest my
life has
purpose!
SERPENT.answer2:
The altar room
of courage gives
the third part
of a key.

SERPENT.name: Lori
SERPENT.answer1:
He is in the
west chamber.
SERPENT.answer2:
He is in the
east chamber.

SERPENT.name: Samuel
SERPENT.answer1:
He is in the
west chamber.
SERPENT.answer2:
He is in the
east chamber.

SERPENT.name: Roderick
SERPENT.answer1:
It was eaten
by a zorn.
SERPENT.answer2:
An orb of blue
light will raise
thy strength,
dexterity or
intelligence,
but at a cost!

SERPENT.name: Sister Antos
SERPENT.answer2:
The bell of
courage is
needed to enter
the abyss.
SERPENT.no:
Then ask the
fighter Garam
for he knows
where it lies!

SERPENT.name: Noxum
SERPENT.answer1:
There are many
ships at the
bottom!
SERPENT.answer2:
A survivor would
know where to
search.
SERPENT.ask:
Hast thou
heard of the
H.M.S. Cape?
SERPENT.yes:
She had a
magical wheel
that would
strengthen her
hull!

SERPENT.name: Michelle
SERPENT.job:
I welcome thee
unto Serpent
Castle!
SERPENT.answer1:
He is the lord
here, take the
west passage.
SERPENT.yes:
Very good,
perhaps thou
seeks Sentri.
SERPENT.no:
Then thou should
visit our
healer!

MOONGLOW.name: Mariah
MOONGLOW.answer1:
Yes, I hope to
go on a great
quest!
MOONGLOW.answer2:
The quest of the
avatar is noble
indeed!
MOONGLOW.yes:
I wish I could
join thee!

MOONGLOW.name: Tracie
MOONGLOW.health:
I feel fine...
if I could just
quit smoking!
MOONGLOW.yes:
I can tell
by the smell!

MOONGLOW.name: Cromwell
MOONGLOW.job:
I speak of the
virtues of
honesty!
MOONGLOW.answer1:
A few honest men
are better than
numbers!
MOONGLOW.answer2:
The mantra of
the shrine
of honesty
is 'AHM'.
MOONGLOW.ask:
Dost thou strive
to be honest?
MOONGLOW.yes:
Then you will
need the mantra.

MOONGLOW.name: Rebelias
MOONGLOW.answer1:
Speak the truth
and shame the
evil forces!
MOONGLOW.answer2:
Evil still
exists in
our hearts
and souls!
MOONGLOW.ask:
Dost thou seek
to conquer thine
own evil?

MOONGLOW.name: Christen
MOONGLOW.answer2:
My friend
William knows
where the rune
of honesty is.

MOONGLOW.name:
Patric the
Humble Shepherd
MOONGLOW.answer1:
Humility is
not derived from
the direct
combination of
truth, love or
courage.
MOONGLOW.answer2:
Humility is to
act and be
humble.

MOONGLOW.name: Shazom
MOONGLOW.job:
I am apprentice
to the great
wizard Nigel!
MOONGLOW.answer1:
I will soon
need to use
the spell he
calls 'recall'.
MOONGLOW.yes:
Seek him out for
he will teach
thee.

MOONGLOW.name: Shakespeare
MOONGLOW.answer1:
Remember, there
is no terror
in threats for
I am strong
in honesty!
MOONGLOW.answer2:
Corruption wins
not more than
honesty!
MOONGLOW.ask:
Dost thou strive
to be honest?

MOONGLOW.name: Browning
MOONGLOW.job:
I strive to live
an honest life!
MOONGLOW.answer1:
An honest soul
need remember
no lies!
MOONGLOW.answer2:
Truth is the
root of honesty!

MOONGLOW.name: Cosima
MOONGLOW.answer1:
I know how best
to mix reagents!
MOONGLOW.answer2:
A sleep spell
actually
requires but
one part
spider silk!
MOONGLOW.ask:
Dost thou know
how to best mix
spells?

MOONGLOW.name: Daranor
MOONGLOW.answer2:
When I die the
world will end!
MOONGLOW.yes:
Then we must
fell the moons!
MOONGLOW.no:
Idiot, you must
think I am
insane!

MOONGLOW.name: Inoo
MOONGLOW.job:
I am a fortune
teller, I read
palms.
MOONGLOW.health:
I predict I will
be fine today!
MOONGLOW.yes:
A great quest
will lead thee
into the abyss
where the codex
awaits!

MOONGLOW.name: Calabrini
MOONGLOW.job:
I bear greetings
from the fair
city of
Moonglow.
MOONGLOW.answer2:
Our healer is
one of the best!
MOONGLOW.ask:
Dost thou seek
an inn or
healing?
MOONGLOW.no:
Perhaps, the
shrine which
lies on an isle
to the north!

MOONGLOW.name: Dekker
MOONGLOW.job:
I earn an honest
living, jesting!
MOONGLOW.answer1:
Honest labor
bears a lovely
face!
MOONGLOW.yes:
We ought to
exchange jokes
sometime!

MOONGLOW.name: William
MOONGLOW.answer1:
It's a peanut
butter and grape
jelly on lightly
toasted bread!
MOONGLOW.answer2:
Search for the
rune of honesty
by Mariah's
gold!

MOONGLOW.name: Tyrone
MOONGLOW.job:
I used to search
for the blue
stone.
MOONGLOW.answer1:
The stone of
honesty is found
on an altar in
the dungeon of
Deceit.
MOONGLOW.answer2:
It is used
within the
dungeon altar
rooms and in
the abyss.

BRITAIN.name: Iolo
BRITAIN.answer1:
I play my lute
and receive the
good wishes of
the people.
BRITAIN.answer2:
If you treat
someone else
well then they
will have reason
to do the same.

BRITAIN.name: Gweno
BRITAIN.job:
I dance and
sing for the
children.
BRITAIN.answer1:
Dance is good
for the soul.
BRITAIN.answer2:
To give to a
beggar shows
compassion.
BRITAIN.ask:
Do you give
to the needy?
BRITAIN.yes:
Beggars are
thankful for
small donations.

BRITAIN.name: a child
BRITAIN.answer1:
The song goes:
Ho eyo he hum!
BRITAIN.answer2:
It means:
Love to one
and all!
BRITAIN.yes:
Then help us
spread the word!

BRITAIN.name: a guard
BRITAIN.answer1:
Across the
bridge our
people dance
and sing!
BRITAIN.ask:
Would thou like
to join them?
BRITAIN.yes:
Remember, an
open heart is
the first step
on the path to
wisdom!
BRITAIN.no:
Then you have
no business
across the
bridge.

BRITAIN.name: Pepper
BRITAIN.answer2:
The rune of
compassion lies
at the end of a
hall somewhere
in this towne.
BRITAIN.no:
Alas, I may have
been able to
help.

BRITAIN.name: Thevel
BRITAIN.job:
I search for
the mystery of
the magic orbs.
BRITAIN.answer1:
A one-handed
beggar knows
their secrets!
BRITAIN.yes:
Only he knows
the orb's gift!
BRITAIN.no:
Find him in
Serpent castle
for he knows of
orbs!

BRITAIN.name: Joe
BRITAIN.job:
Yo ho ho...
and a bottle...
of rum...
hic...
BRITAIN.answer1:
The yellow stone
is in the
dungeon
Despise...
BRITAIN.yes:
Thanxth...
my friend Joe
can help with
the stones...
hic...

BRITAIN.name: Cricket
BRITAIN.answer2:
The mantra for
the shrine of
compassion
is 'MU'!
BRITAIN.no:
I am going to
call the guards!

BRITAIN.name: a guard
BRITAIN.job:
I am a guard
of course!
BRITAIN.answer1:
We guards have
a lot of
compassion.
BRITAIN.answer2:
We always say:
Let all others'
troubles be as
thine own!

BRITAIN.name: a child
BRITAIN.answer1:
The solution to
ones problems
often lies in
solving others!
BRITAIN.answer2:
Never care so
much for thyself
that thou cannot
care for others!
BRITAIN.ask:
Know ye the
mantra of
compassion?

BRITAIN.name: Shalimar
BRITAIN.answer1:
It takes a
good deal of
compassion to
deal with
children!
BRITAIN.answer2:
Compassion
strengthens the
soul as
knowledge
tempers the
mind!
BRITAIN.yes:
Thou dost know
what I mean!

BRITAIN.name: Sebastian
BRITAIN.answer1:
Mondain's
influence has
not left the
world!
BRITAIN.answer2:
An artifact
remains! I heard
at Buccaneer's
Den!
BRITAIN.ask:
Wilt thou find
and destroy it?
BRITAIN.yes:
Then ask at the
pub there of
the skull!

BRITAIN.name: Shapero
BRITAIN.answer1:
He knows the
true nature of
compassion.
BRITAIN.answer2:
Seek out Julio
and ask him of
compassion!
BRITAIN.ask:
Art thou on the
Quest of the
Avatar?
BRITAIN.yes:
Find the shrine
of compassion
east across 2
bridges!

BRITAIN.name: Julio
BRITAIN.job:
I seek the
true nature
of things!
BRITAIN.answer1:
All things have
a true nature!
BRITAIN.answer2:
Compassion
derives itself
from unending
love!
BRITAIN.ask:
Dost thou know
the true nature
of all things?
BRITAIN.yes:
Thou art a liar
and a braggart.

BRITAIN.name: Mentor
BRITAIN.answer1:
Pride was too
great in
Magincia!
BRITAIN.answer2:
The city was
destroyed by
daemons for
its pride!
BRITAIN.no:
Pride exists
without truth,
love, or
courage!

BRITAIN.name: Sprite
BRITAIN.job:
I have no job so
now I beg!
BRITAIN.health:
I fear I
shall die of
starvation!
BRITAIN.answer1:
I have not eaten
in a week!
BRITAIN.yes:
In return I
shall tell thee
that Pepper
knows of the
rune!

JHELOM.name: Geoffrey
JHELOM.answer1:
A great warrior
is a valiant
warrior!
JHELOM.answer2:
I desire to
fight again in
battle!
JHELOM.yes:
Perhaps I could
someday join
thee!

JHELOM.name: Lord Robert
JHELOM.answer1:
Thou must battle
long and hard
to be a warrior.
JHELOM.answer2:
Battles are few
and too many!
JHELOM.yes:
Thou dost
deserve the
rune, ask
Nostro!

JHELOM.name: Lady Donna
JHELOM.health:
Fine, all but
the lump in
my stomach.
JHELOM.answer1:
It's no fun
to be pregnant.
JHELOM.yes:
Wait till I
tell my husband!

JHELOM.name: Bengrod
JHELOM.answer2:
Therein use the
stones found in
the connecting
dungeons!
JHELOM.ask:
Hast thou found
its altar room?
JHELOM.yes:
It connects with
Covetous, Shame
and Hythloth!

JHELOM.name: Sir William
JHELOM.answer1:
Kill not
non-evil
creatures but
still always
stand thy
ground!
JHELOM.answer2:
Let them flee
instead.
never
flee uninjured!
JHELOM.yes:
Strive ye to
defeat all evil!

JHELOM.name: Sir Hrothgar
JHELOM.answer1:
The valiant soul
fears not its
own visage!
JHELOM.answer2:
The mantra need
be known, ask
Aesop!
JHELOM.ask:
Art thou the
most valiant of
souls?
JHELOM.no:
Thou should seek
the shrine of
valor!

JHELOM.name: a guard
JHELOM.job:
We guard the
gates and these
passages!

JHELOM.name: Aesop
JHELOM.answer1:
I find that 'tis
easy to be brave
from a safe
distance!
JHELOM.answer2:
The mantra of
valor is 'RA'
use it in the
shrine on the
next isle!

JHELOM.name: Gravnor
JHELOM.answer2:
It is found on
an altar!
JHELOM.yes:
No wonder I
can't find it!
JHELOM.no:
It lies in the
dungeon Destard!

JHELOM.name: Senora
JHELOM.job:
I am locked up
in this tower.
JHELOM.answer1:
I am being
punished for my
crimes.
JHELOM.answer2:
Does not matter,
I can help thee!
JHELOM.yes:
Then thou dost
need a sextant
ask the barkeep
for he knows
more!

JHELOM.name: Nostro
JHELOM.job:
I built these
passages and
they walled
me in!
JHELOM.answer1:
This passage
runs around the
city!
JHELOM.answer2:
The rune is
buried in a
tower!
JHELOM.no:
Thou art a cad!
and I will still
follow!

JHELOM.name: Luke
JHELOM.look:
A ranger with a
far away look.
JHELOM.answer1:
I come from
Skara Brae and
am on my way to
Yew.
JHELOM.answer2:
'tis a city
based in the
virtue of
justice!
JHELOM.ask:
Hast thou been
to Skara Brae?

JHELOM.name: Max
JHELOM.answer2:
That's a strange
one at the
end. People
often disappear.
JHELOM.ask:
Is there some
problem with thy
room?
JHELOM.yes:
I am very sorry
I will correct
it right away!

JHELOM.name: X
JHELOM.answer2:
Red is for valor
a virtue of the
avatar!
JHELOM.no:
Then thou shalt
need the red
stone in one
altar room to
get the third
part of a key!

JHELOM.name: Slithe
JHELOM.answer1:
True valor is
seen not in the
force of arms,
but in the force
of will!
JHELOM.answer2:
I display my
valor in battle.
JHELOM.yes:
Then never flee
unless the need
is dire!

JHELOM.name: Timrod
JHELOM.answer1:
There is no
holier spot of
ground than
where defeated
valor lies.
JHELOM.answer2:
Be brave for
there is much
to dare!

YEW.name: Jaana
YEW.answer1:
True justice
satisfies all,
false none.
YEW.answer2:
Let justice be
thy calling not
thy excuse!
YEW.yes:
Many a grave has
been unjustly
filled in the
name of justice.

YEW.name: a guard
YEW.answer1:
A good life is
inspired by love
and guided by
knowledge.
YEW.answer2:
Within this
chamber justice
is served.
YEW.ask:
Dost thou have
business before
the court?
YEW.no:
Then do not
disturb the
proceedings!

YEW.name: a guard
YEW.answer2:
That'll be the
right hand cell.
careful in
there!
YEW.ask:
Hast thou come
to turn thyself
in?
YEW.yes:
In which cell
dost thou
belong, felonies
or misdemeanors.

YEW.name: Calumny
YEW.answer2:
Mandrake root is
found only in
the Fens of the
Dead and in the
Bloody Plains
where the ground
is always damp.

YEW.name: Talfourd
YEW.ask:
Can thou
honestly claim
to be guilty of
no crime ever?
YEW.no:
Then do thy
penance in a
cell, and with
the felon
search ye well.

YEW.name: Flamis
YEW.job:
I hold the
fabric of the
true nature of
justice.
YEW.answer1:
The virtue of
justice draws
its nature from
the principles
of truth and
love!

YEW.name: Dwp
YEW.job:
Welcome thee to
Yew city of
justice!
YEW.answer1:
Love no one more
than the truth,
for justice
seeks no favors.
Temper thy
justice with
understanding.

YEW.name: a poor beggar.
YEW.answer1:
I have gotten
chests in the
townes and
killed non-evil
creatures.
YEW.answer2:
He is a mean
nasty ugly
villain!
YEW.ask:
Should thou be
in with the
felon?
YEW.yes:
Thou art in the
wrong cell.

YEW.name: Vorpal
YEW.job:
I eat people
who bug me!
YEW.ask:
Art thou here
to bug me?

YEW.name: a ranger
YEW.answer2:
Where the deer
and the antelope
play.
YEW.ask:
Ever heard of
such a place?
YEW.yes:
Seldom is heard
a discouraging
word!
YEW.no:
Ah, what'ya have
to ruin it for!

YEW.name: Short Round
YEW.answer1:
I think Indi's
on a quest!
YEW.answer2:
I'm not so sure,
but it should be
fun!
YEW.yes:
Write to Lord
British and tell
him!!!
YEW.no:
I am so sorry we
all wish you
would!

YEW.name: Frida
YEW.job:
See my poor baby
I beg for him.
YEW.answer1:
Oh, no, my baby
is dying!
YEW.ask:
Wilt thou give
me money so that
I can get my
baby healed?

YEW.name: Pinrod
YEW.answer2:
Justice is
hardest to find
at the point of
a sword, the
steel is an
agent of
justice,
humanity the
perpetrator!
YEW.yes:
Good, the
druids chant
the mantra!

YEW.name: a guard
YEW.job:
To preserve
the peace and
insure justice!
YEW.answer1:
A good life is
inspired by love
and guided by
truth!
YEW.answer2:
Justice means
not only to
punish the bad
but also to
reward the good!

YEW.name: Druid
YEW.answer2:
The shrine is to
the east then
north!
YEW.yes:
Now learn the
mantra, and seek
the green stone
in 'Wrong'!
YEW.no:
Ask Talfourd for
he knows of the
rune.

MINOC.name: Julia
MINOC.answer1:
Self
preservation is
the first law of
nature; self
sacrifice the
highest rule
of grace.
MINOC.answer2:
Within this
house are many
poor and
destitute souls.

MINOC.name: Zircon
MINOC.answer2:
Ah, yes, the
mystic weapons,
and armour, my
greatest work!
Those I gave
unto Sir Simon
and Lady Tessa.

MINOC.name: Bob the Beggar
MINOC.health:
I am very sick,
help me!
MINOC.answer1:
I need money
to cure my
sickness.
MINOC.yes:
Then please
share it
with me!
MINOC.no:
Then join me and
we can beg
together!

MINOC.name: Linda Sue
MINOC.answer1:
I have not eaten
in days.
MINOC.answer2:
Oh, thou art
a kind soul!
MINOC.ask:
Could thou spare
a nibble of
food?

MINOC.name: Gimble
MINOC.answer1:
I suffer from a
tsetse byte!
MINOC.ask:
Could thou spare
a gold piece so
I may buy a
last drink?
MINOC.yes:
Remember Azure
knows of the
rune!

MINOC.name: Jude
MINOC.answer1:
I will not speak
of my sin!
MINOC.ask:
If I help thee
wilt thou swear
to only use it
at the mouth of
the abyss to
destroy it?
MINOC.yes:
It can be found
at lat-P'F"
long-M'F" on the
darkest night!

MINOC.name: Alkerion
MINOC.job:
I am a peasant,
I hear many
things.
MINOC.answer1:
What does thou
wish to know?
MINOC.answer2:
The stone of
sacrifice is
orange in color
and used in the
altar rooms of
love and
courage!

MINOC.name: Mike Ward
MINOC.job:
I am trying to
get a room.
MINOC.answer1:
I have travelled
clear from
Skara Brae.
MINOC.answer2:
The rune of our
city is missing!
MINOC.yes:
It is the key to
the shrine of
spirituality!
MINOC.no:
It is not in
Skara Brae.

MINOC.name: Alex
MINOC.job:
I give out
flowers. Here
you are!
MINOC.answer1:
The way I figure
it, if thou art
kind to others
they will have
reason to be
kind in return!
MINOC.answer2:
Yes, give all
that thou can
unto the needy!

MINOC.name: Shentis
MINOC.job:
I welcome thee
unto Minoc, city
of sacrifice!
MINOC.yes:
Then perhaps
thou shalt
become an
avatar!

MINOC.name: Singsong
MINOC.answer2:
Very well,
the raven sings,
the raven saw
and in the corn
he sayeth 'CAH'.

MINOC.name: Damon
MINOC.answer2:
Listen to the
bard's song for
in its verse
lies the key!
MINOC.ask:
Can't a man
just think
to himself?
MINOC.no:
Oh, yes
I can thou
bandersnatch!

MINOC.name: Mischief
MINOC.answer2:
The rune of
sacrifice is
hard to get. It
lies within the
fires of the
forge!
MINOC.yes:
Then ask
Alkerion of the
stone!
MINOC.no:
Return when thou
dost find it!

MINOC.name: Azure
MINOC.answer1:
I carve runes
for passage into
the shrines!

MINOC.name: Merida
MINOC.job:
I seek the
wisdom of the
shrine of
sacrifice.
MINOC.answer1:
But first I need
the mantra!
MINOC.answer2:
I am told that a
hidden shepherd
knows the
mantra.
MINOC.no:
The shrine is on
a lake to the
east!

MINOC.name: a guard
MINOC.answer1:
I often wonder
if I will ever
have to give my
life in the line
of duty.
MINOC.yes:
Of course, if it
came down to it,
I hope I would
do it!

TRINSIC.name: Dupre
TRINSIC.ask:
Dost thou try to
live honorably?
TRINSIC.yes:
It is a constant
quest. Honor is
like finely
polished armour.
Without constant
care, it will
soon tarnish!

TRINSIC.name: Virgil
TRINSIC.answer2:
Nightshade may
be found only
near lat-J'F"
long-C'O" only on
the darkest of
nights!

TRINSIC.name: Publius
TRINSIC.job:
I drink a toast
to honor!
TRINSIC.answer1:
What is left
when honor is
lost?
TRINSIC.answer2:
Right, take
honor from me
and my life is
done!
TRINSIC.ask:
Dost thou strive
to live an
honorable life?

TRINSIC.name: Skitle
TRINSIC.answer2:
I have seen the
purple stone
used in the
altars of
truth and
courage!
TRINSIC.no:
It holds items
thou shalt need.

TRINSIC.name: Sailor Sam
TRINSIC.job:
I sail the
the seas of
Britannia!
TRINSIC.answer2:
Go to the pub in
Jhelom and ask
of sextants.
TRINSIC.no:
Thou must
not own a
sextant, eh?

TRINSIC.name: Aristotle
TRINSIC.answer1:
Dignity
consists not
in possessing
honors, but in
deserving them.
TRINSIC.answer2:
Honor no one,
but honor
itself!
TRINSIC.ask:
Art thou
honorable at all
times?

TRINSIC.name: Terrin
TRINSIC.answer1:
A big one, with
long, pointy
horns!
TRINSIC.answer2:
It is buried in
the southwest
corner of towne.
TRINSIC.yes:
Whew, I thought
it would get me!

TRINSIC.name: Rigmore
TRINSIC.answer1:
Yes, welcome to
Trinsic city of
honor!
TRINSIC.answer2:
Wisdom on the
virtue of honor
is found
throughout this
towne.

TRINSIC.name: Winthrop
TRINSIC.answer2:
There is a small
child who knew
named... Terrin.
TRINSIC.no:
Find him and ask
of the rune!

TRINSIC.name: Swindrik
TRINSIC.answer2:
Ask at the
Folley tavern
of mandrake.
TRINSIC.ask:
Dost thou cast
spells of great
power?
TRINSIC.yes:
What is the
most powerful
reagent?
TRINSIC.no:
Dost thou know
their main
ingredient?

TRINSIC.name: Kline
TRINSIC.job:
I seek entry to
the shrine of
honor!
TRINSIC.answer2:
A man named
Winthrop knows
of the rune!
TRINSIC.ask:
Know ye the two
requirements to
enter and use
the shrine?

TRINSIC.name: Lexington
TRINSIC.answer2:
The solving of
quests brings ye
honor!
TRINSIC.yes:
Then solve
quests but
attack not
non-evil
creatures, and
get not
others gold!

TRINSIC.name: Dergin
TRINSIC.job:
I seek a place
to rest.
TRINSIC.answer1:
I have quested
long and hard.
TRINSIC.answer2:
I seek
enlightenment
at the shrine of
honor!
TRINSIC.no:
The shrine lies
to the south and
west beyond the
swamps!

TRINSIC.name: a guard
TRINSIC.ask:
Dost thou strive
to bring honor
upon the peers?
TRINSIC.yes:
Dupre, the
leader of our
towne, joins
many honorable
quests!

TRINSIC.name: Quix
TRINSIC.answer2:
About the purple
stone of honor!
TRINSIC.ask:
Dost thou have
the purple
stone?
TRINSIC.no:
Seek it for it
is very useful!

SKARA.name: Shamino
SKARA.answer2:
That which
lies within
the codex!
SKARA.yes:
Some things take
forever but
brick by brick
mountains can be
built!

SKARA.name: Emerson
SKARA.answer1:
Spiritual is
stronger than
any material
force.
SKARA.answer2:
Nothing can
bring thee peace
but the triumph
of principles!

SKARA.name: Santayana
SKARA.job:
I carry the
light within my
heart.
SKARA.answer2:
In philosophical
minds the
familiar excites
wonder!
SKARA.ask:
Dost thou always
tread the right
path?
SKARA.no:
Few can, but
strive to do so!

SKARA.name: Presto
SKARA.answer1:
I can cast:
jinx, kill,
and view!
SKARA.answer2:
Yes, ask the
barkeep at
'The Axe-n-Ale'
in Vesper about
nightshade.
SKARA.ask:
Dost thou know
what these
spells have in
common?

SKARA.name: Granted
SKARA.job:
I beg for food
and money.
SKARA.health:
I am not
at all well.
SKARA.ask:
Wilt thou give
me food or
money?
SKARA.yes:
In return I will
tell thee that
the ankh knows
of the rune and
my friend Ambule
knows the
mantra!

SKARA.name: Mitre
SKARA.job:
I am reading the
wizard's journal.
SKARA.answer1:
It tells of the
white stone.
SKARA.answer2:
It is no longer
in the dungeon
Hythloth, it
is gone!
SKARA.ask:
Wilt thou try to
recover it?
SKARA.yes:
Ask of the stone
at the Tap in
Trinsic!

SKARA.name: Buddha
SKARA.answer1:
When one has
pity on all
living creatures
then is one
noble.
SKARA.answer2:
If one speaks or
acts with pure
thought,
happiness will
follow like a
shadow that
never leaves.

SKARA.name: Michaelangelo
SKARA.answer1:
Success is a
journey, not a
destination.
SKARA.answer2:
May thou always
desire more than
thou can
accomplish!
SKARA.ask:
Art thou far
along the path?

SKARA.name: Romasco
SKARA.look:
A short dumpy
man with a book.
SKARA.job:
I am a teacher,
I enrich young
minds.
SKARA.answer2:
Seek Zair the
Wise in Paws for
more on the
word.
SKARA.yes:
A word of
passage is
needed at the
last gate!

SKARA.name: Carlyle
SKARA.answer1:
One lives by
believing in
something.
SKARA.answer2:
Great
discoveries are
made by those
whose feelings
run ahead of
their thinking.
SKARA.yes:
Magic missiles
need but 1
part ash!

SKARA.name: Dickens
SKARA.answer1:
Stories are good
for the spirit!
SKARA.answer2:
Remember,
no one is
useless in this
world who
lightens the
burdens of
others!
SKARA.yes:
Be sure thy net
good well
exceeds thy
net evil!

SKARA.name: White
SKARA.answer2:
I am not afraid
of tomorrow; I
have seen
yesterday and I
love today.
SKARA.ask:
Art thou
fearless in all
thing?

SKARA.name:
the Ankh of
Spirituality
SKARA.job:
I keep the
secret of
the rune.
SKARA.answer2:
Search for
the rune of
spirituality in
the treasure
chamber of
Britannia!
SKARA.no:
Enter the gate
of full moons!

SKARA.name: Ambule
SKARA.job:
I beg for but
for a single
gold piece!
SKARA.ask:
Wilt thou please
give me a
gold piece?
SKARA.no:
Stingy, I know
thou hast many!

SKARA.name: Barren
SKARA.answer1:
I know it well,
it is 'OM'.

SKARA.name: Isaac
SKARA.answer2:
The white stone
sits atop the
Serpent's Spine.
It can only be
reached by one
who floats
within the
clouds.

MAGINCIA.name: Katrina
MAGINCIA.answer1:
Magincia was
destroyed by its
pride.
MAGINCIA.answer2:
Pride flourishes
in the absence
of truth, love
and courage.
MAGINCIA.no:
Humility is the
virtue that
must overcome
pride!

MAGINCIA.name: Ghostly
MAGINCIA.answer1:
Peace I can
never find,
forever banished
unto the realm
of earthbound
spirits.
MAGINCIA.answer2:
Be not proud of
thy little deeds
lest ye too fall
from the light!

MAGINCIA.name: Skullface
MAGINCIA.job:
I am a nobleman
of great birth.
MAGINCIA.answer1:
Me and my
brother are the
last two of the
great Meridid
family.
MAGINCIA.ask:
Thou hast heard
of us of course,
yes?
MAGINCIA.no:
You must not be
from near these
parts!

MAGINCIA.name: Casperin
MAGINCIA.answer1:
A lot of
haunting goes on
round here.
MAGINCIA.answer2:
Seek ye the
mantra for
humility, ask ye
Heywood!
MAGINCIA.yes:
Pride is the
surest measure
of goals never
attained!

MAGINCIA.name: Faultless
MAGINCIA.answer1:
I was hung for
my sin of pride!
MAGINCIA.answer2:
The mantra for
pride, being
the antithesis
of humility,
is 'MUL'.

MAGINCIA.name: Heywood
MAGINCIA.health:
As well as can
be expected.
MAGINCIA.answer1:
Pride goeth
before, shame
cometh after!
MAGINCIA.answer2:
Faultless knows
the mantra of
pride ask him!
MAGINCIA.no:
A proud soul
surely knows not
its worth!

MAGINCIA.name: Slim
MAGINCIA.health:
A bit on the
thin side.
MAGINCIA.answer1:
I did value
myself far too
greatly, that
pride was my
downfall.
MAGINCIA.no:
Take no pride in
humility, lest
ye destroy it!

MAGINCIA.name: Banter
MAGINCIA.job:
I once held the
silver horn.
MAGINCIA.answer1:
The silver horn
must be used to
pass the daemon
guard of the
shrine.
MAGINCIA.answer2:
Wierdrum has
been to the
shrine of
humility!

MAGINCIA.name: Demitry
MAGINCIA.answer1:
Bones, them
bones, them
dry bones...
MAGINCIA.answer2:
The queen of
love has a lady
in waiting, she
can tell thee
more of the
horn!

MAGINCIA.name: Wierdrum
MAGINCIA.job:
I haunt,
and I haunt,
and I haunt!
MAGINCIA.answer1:
A haunting job
takes more than
a lifetime, it
takes forever!
MAGINCIA.answer2:
Yes, I have been
to the shrine,
it lies on the
north bank in
the isle of the
abyss!

MAGINCIA.name: Boozer
MAGINCIA.job:
I was once
a powerful
merchant!
MAGINCIA.answer1:
My wealth
was boundless,
I held great
power!
MAGINCIA.answer2:
A proud soul
surely knows not
it's worth!
MAGINCIA.yes:
The world goes
on without me.
MAGINCIA.no:
The world goes
on without me.

MAGINCIA.name: Bulbous
MAGINCIA.answer1:
Why, the food
shop of course.
MAGINCIA.answer2:
Well, we're
expecting more
any day!
MAGINCIA.ask:
Can I interest
thee in some
rations?
MAGINCIA.yes:
Hmmm, our stock
seems to have
spoiled....
MAGINCIA.no:
I sell only the
very best.

MAGINCIA.name: Splot
MAGINCIA.answer1:
I was proud,
strip thyself of
conceits, only
the humble are
pure!
MAGINCIA.answer2:
The root from
which all
virtues grow!
MAGINCIA.yes:
Then ask the
snake of the
rune and stone!

MAGINCIA.name: Ruskin
MAGINCIA.job:
I now try to
understand
humility.
MAGINCIA.answer1:
The first test
of a great soul
is humility!
MAGINCIA.answer2:
Ask the snake of
the rune, just
before it
strikes!
MAGINCIA.ask:
Dost thou seek
to know
humility?

MAGINCIA.name: Nate
MAGINCIA.job:
I bring death
to all life in
Magincia!
MAGINCIA.answer1:
Those who seek
the black stone
need ask at the
pub in Britain!
MAGINCIA.answer2:
The sacred rune
of humility was
banished from
this city. Ask
Barren in Paws!

MAGINCIA.name: Virtuebane
MAGINCIA.job:
I welcome thee
to Magincia!
Proud city of
the high seas!
MAGINCIA.answer1:
Magincia fell
unto the realm
of darkness for
the foundation
of their virtue
was ill-placed
in pride!

PAWS.name: Wilmoore
PAWS.job:
I am the chief
guard in the
village of Paws!
PAWS.answer1:
Paws is a great
village and we
keep it safe!
PAWS.answer2:
Pirates come
from an isle to
the east!
PAWS.ask:
Dost thou
mean to
cause trouble?

PAWS.name: Francesca
PAWS.answer1:
I saw the way ya
dealt with ol'
Red Eye!
PAWS.ask:
Ya haven't come
to steal a horse
I hope?
PAWS.yes:
Well the master
ain't gonna like
that much!
PAWS.no:
Then must be
to see Smith!

PAWS.name: Sven
PAWS.answer1:
Wit' my axe, I
can chop'm down
quick, ya.

PAWS.name: Zair the Wise
PAWS.answer2:
A three part key
and a word of
passage are
needed to enter
the chamber. Ask
my brother
beyond Lock Lake
of the word!

PAWS.name: Sal
PAWS.job:
I am the barmaid
I serve the ale!
PAWS.answer1:
We have the
finest brew in
Britannia!
PAWS.answer2:
We serve only
Folley on tap!
PAWS.yes:
A great mug if I
may say so!

PAWS.name: Jingles
PAWS.job:
I seek the
wisdom of magic.
PAWS.answer1:
My master knows
the gate travel
spell!
PAWS.no:
He lives in a
hidden village
in Lock Lake
reachable only
by ship, ask of
the gate spell!

PAWS.name: Sir Hobie
PAWS.health:
Tired and
hungry but
always faithful.
PAWS.answer2:
My quest is to
defeat the evils
of the world.

PAWS.name: Damsel
PAWS.job:
I am here to
buy food.
PAWS.answer1:
Yes, I hear they
have the best
rations here.
PAWS.ask:
Dost thou travel
in the depths?
PAWS.yes:
In the great
castle there is
a secret
entrance!

PAWS.name: Wheatpin
PAWS.answer1:
Around there in
the nook of the
mountains!

PAWS.name: Barren
PAWS.answer2:
Search the
hills in the
south-east
corner of town!

PAWS.name: Sir Simon
PAWS.answer2:
Mystics can be
found by an
eight parts
avatar!
PAWS.ask:
Hast thou
attained
enlightenment in
all eight
virtues?
PAWS.yes:
The mystic
armour lies in
the center of
the oak grove!

PAWS.name: Lady Tessa
PAWS.answer2:
Mystics can be
found by an
eight parts
avatar!
PAWS.ask:
Hast thou
attained
enlightenment in
all eight
virtues?
PAWS.yes:
The mystic
weapons lie in
the training
room of Serpent
castle!

PAWS.name: Asemly
PAWS.job:
I am here to
serve thee.
PAWS.answer1:
Well, I can
dance and sing!
PAWS.no:
Well then, I
guess I'm no
help at all
then.

PAWS.name: Little Jon
PAWS.answer1:
Britannia is a
land so fair,
to other lands I
would not dare!
PAWS.answer2:
I hope someday
thou may return!
PAWS.ask:
I hear that thou
art from another
world?

DEN.name: Roofus
DEN.yes:
Thou had best
ditch it then!

DEN.name: Rankbreath
DEN.ask:
Art thou here
to feed me?

DEN.name: Sailor
DEN.answer2:
As I sail across
the bounding
sea!
DEN.yes:
And never ever
ever do I worry
'bout the
weather, for the
weather never
ever did a thing
for me!

DEN.name: Silver John
DEN.answer1:
We raid the
coasts of
Britannia, fun
eh!
DEN.no:
Thou had best
leave this place
'fore there's
any trouble!

DEN.name: Slysam
DEN.health:
As good as
I need be!
DEN.answer2:
Thou dost ask
too many
questions!

DEN.name: Ragnar
DEN.answer2:
Be warned that
if thou dost
ever use the
skull, except to
destroy it, all
thy virtues will
be lost!
DEN.ask:
Art thou here
looking for
information?

DEN.name: Seanna
DEN.answer1:
How about the
sleep spell...
sleep...
sleep....
DEN.answer2:
A sleep spell
requires but one
part silk!
sleep...
sleep...
sleep...
DEN.ask:
My dear friend,
may I help you?

DEN.name:
Jeremy James
Scirlock
DEN.answer2:
The dungeon
Hythloth can
only be reached
by a secret
entrance in the
great castle.
DEN.ask:
Dost thou seek a
special dungeon?

DEN.name: Starlight
DEN.look:
A mage dressed
all in black.
DEN.answer1:
I cast powerful
magic missile
spells.
DEN.answer2:
Try one black
pearl and one
part sulfurous
ash!
DEN.yes:
Thou should try
my mix of
reagents!

DEN.name: Boris
DEN.answer1:
Magic keys,
magic gems,
that sort
of thing.
DEN.ask:
Dost thou need
such an item?
DEN.yes:
I just gave the
guild shop a new
supply!

DEN.name: Ignap
DEN.answer1:
To step into
those woods will
seal thy doom!
DEN.answer2:
In there lies
the dark side,
enter not!

DEN.name: Green Beard
DEN.look:
A tall pirate
with a green
beard!
DEN.job:
I'm buying
armour for my
crew!
DEN.answer1:
I hope to get
some magical
plate!
DEN.ask:
Know where to
buy mystic
armour?

DEN.name: Marsor
DEN.answer2:
I own my own
vineyards, they
are on an isle
northeast of
here!
DEN.yes:
Ah, then join me
in a glass!
DEN.no:
Don't know
what thou
art missing!

DEN.name: Dancek
DEN.job:
I am a tinker
by trade.
DEN.yes:
Good odds I
built the
cannons!

DEN.name: Sniflet
DEN.ask:
Wilt thou
promise to use
it only to aid
the powers of
good?
DEN.yes:
The lighter than
air device that
was stolen lies
near the dungeon
Hythloth!

VESPER.name: Twin Gates
VESPER.answer1:
Yes, Vesper is a
fair village.
VESPER.ask:
Hast thou come
a long way?
VESPER.yes:
We are honored
by the visit of
one on the
quest!
VESPER.no:
We are honored
by the visit of
one on the
quest!

VESPER.name: Servile
VESPER.answer1:
I know of the
skull of Mondain
the Wizard!
VESPER.answer2:
To use it for
any reason is a
sign of great
evil, and no
virtue!

VESPER.name: Traveling Dan
VESPER.look:
Short rotund man
with a hat and
vest.
VESPER.answer1:
I am here to
repair goods at
the guild shop.
VESPER.answer2:
I know the world
is round!

VESPER.name: Balthasar
VESPER.answer1:
Serfs work hard
for little pay!
VESPER.answer2:
I work the
fields for my
master!
VESPER.yes:
I hope he or she
is a kind one!

VESPER.name: Plain
VESPER.answer1:
When the 3
principles of
virtue combine
in eight ways
pride has no
virtue!
VESPER.answer2:
To be proud is
not a virtue,
and so Magincia
was destroyed!
Humility is the
virtue that
remains!

VESPER.name: Simple
VESPER.answer2:
The shrine lies
on the north
bank of the isle
of the abyss and
is guarded by
endless hoards
of daemons!

VESPER.name: Gem
VESPER.answer1:
I can help thee
with the mantra!
VESPER.answer2:
Since humility
is the opposite
of pride, so is
its mantra!
VESPER.ask:
Know ye the
mantra of pride?

VESPER.name: Joseph
VESPER.job:
I am but a
humble shepherd.
VESPER.answer1:
I am on a
pilgrimage unto
the shrine of
humility!
VESPER.answer2:
It is on the
dark island!
VESPER.ask:
Did thou know
that there is no
shrine of pride?
VESPER.no:
Pride is not a
virtue of the
avatar!

VESPER.name: Friday
VESPER.job:
I shall warn
thee against
taking this
gold!
VESPER.ask:
Dost thou intend
to take it?
VESPER.yes:
That would not
reflect well
upon thy
virtues!

VESPER.name: Randal
VESPER.answer1:
One >must< visit
each shrine for
1, 2 & 3 cycles
each for thy
paths to be
clear!
VESPER.no:
Make that the
first goal along
thy path to
avatarhood!

VESPER.name: Dirgen
VESPER.answer1:
Strive ye to
know and
develop the
virtue within
thee.
VESPER.answer2:
The Seer
Hawkwind should
be consulted
>often< for he
can see within
thee!
VESPER.no:
Thou shalt
surely stray
from the path!

VESPER.name: Shazbot
VESPER.answer1:
I dare thee to
ask me about
Nate the snake!
VESPER.answer2:
Well, it's a
long story and
we haven't the
time.
VESPER.yes:
Well good, I
try to be!
VESPER.no:
Ah, too bad, I
thought I was.

VESPER.name: Flatbush
VESPER.no:
Calumny knows
the quickness
spell! Seek
him out!

VESPER.name: Corkrin
VESPER.job:
I travel these
fair lands to
spread the
virtues!
VESPER.answer1:
To know thy
progress on the
paths of virtue
one >must< visit
the Seer
Hawkwind often!
VESPER.no:
Thou must or
thou may stray!

VESPER.name: Dyka
VESPER.job:
I am a thief, I
like to borrow!
VESPER.answer1:
My favorite
things to borrow
are horses!
VESPER.answer2:
You can steal
horses in the
towne Paws!
VESPER.yes:
Watch out for
the bull in the
corral!

COVE.name: Allen
COVE.job:
I know how to
enter the abyss!
COVE.answer1:
The abyss
may only
be approached
by ship!
COVE.answer2:
The ship must
have a magically
strengthened
hull!

COVE.name: Frontis
COVE.job:
Welcome to Cove,
the hidden city
of wisdom.
COVE.answer1:
Herein is found
much wisdom and
peace.
COVE.no:
Visit our
healers, I am
sure they can
help thee!

COVE.name: Sloven
COVE.answer2:
Only the ghost
of Isaac who
haunts the inn
at Skara Brae
can tell thee.
COVE.no:
Stay at the inn
until he shows
himself!

COVE.name: Mentorian
COVE.answer2:
Since thou dost
bear the ankh I
shall tell thee.
A gate spell
requires ash,
pearl, and
mandrake root!

COVE.name: the ankh
COVE.answer2:
One must be 8
parts avatar,
have the key of
3 parts, the
word of passage
and know the
pure axiom!

COVE.name: Paul
COVE.answer1:
I light a
candle to our
love, in love
our problems
disappear.
COVE.answer2:
But all in all
we soon discover
that one and one
is all we long
to hear!

COVE.name: Linda
COVE.answer1:
All round the
world, little
children being
born to the
world.
COVE.answer2:
Got to give them
all we can 'til
the quest is
won, then will
the work be
done!

COVE.name: Merlin
COVE.answer1:
The black stone
is caught in a
moon gate!
COVE.answer2:
Stand where the
gate of both
moons dark shall
appear. Search
when the moons
go dark!
COVE.yes:
Best of luck
with thy
studies!

COVE.name: Draconian
COVE.answer1:
There are
eight possible
combinations of
truth, love and
courage. Each
of the eight
virtues is one
of those
combinations!

COVE.name: Blissful
COVE.job:
I know much
of the codex!
COVE.answer1:
The shrine ankh
knows how to
enter the
chamber of the
codex!
COVE.answer2:
Meditate at
the shrines
of honesty,
compassion and
valor for 3
cycles to know
how to enter!

COVE.name:
Rabindranath
tagore
COVE.answer1:
In love,
all life's
contradictions
dissolve and
disappear.
COVE.ask:
Dost thou seek
to carry love in
thy heart?

COVE.name: Brother Zair
COVE.job:
I sit and watch
the river.
COVE.answer2:
The kings of the
castles which
represent the
three principles
of virtue each
know but one
syllable of the
word of passage!

COVE.name: Spellbind
COVE.answer1:
One must know
the combination
of the three
principles of
virtue!
COVE.answer2:
The combination
of the three
principles of
virtue equals
the measure of
time and space!

COVE.name: Shaman
COVE.job:
I study the
'one' thing that
is the secret to
the codex!
COVE.answer2:
The one pure
axiom is more
endless than the
changing tides,
more eternal
than day and
night!

COVE.name: Charm
COVE.job:
I ponder the key
to the axiom.
COVE.answer2:
The 1 pure axiom
encompasses
all things.
COVE.no:
The truths of
the universe,
the love of the
heart, and the
courage of the
soul!

COVE.name: Circe
COVE.answer1:
The whole of the
axiom is greater
than all its
parts!
COVE.answer2:
The measure of
unending love,
the limitless
courage needed
to face all
obstacles,the
truth which
encompasses all
things!
